subject: Television & Streaming
title: Orange Is the New Black and Incarceration
description: A short lesson to help you apply Orange Is the New Black and Incarceration.

hook.text: In 2013, Netflix released Orange Is the New Black—a show set in a women's prison that humanized incarcerated people.

buildup.text: The show featured diverse characters: transgender, Black, Latina, elderly.

discovery.text: Laverne Cox became the first openly transgender person on the cover of Time magazine thanks to her role on the show.

twist.text: The show made prison reform personal.

climax.text: Orange Is the New Black and Incarceration matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: A prison comedy made America care about prisoners.

quiz.question: What social impact did Orange Is the New Black have?
options: It humanized incarcerated people and raised awareness about prison reform
